response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT ma.department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), s AS (SELECT department, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM d) AS share FROM d), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
